name: boss-agent-cli-referentially-safe-crawl-2455
instr:
boss-agent-cli lacks reference-aware crawl retention for safely previewing erasure, executing an approved plan, and inspecting a durable receipt. Preserve consistency across stored rows, JSON, CSV, and XLSX artifacts, shortlist and workflow state, and automation evidence. When retention is unused, keep existing crawl, resume, shortlist, output, and recovery behavior.

Give each run an immutable lifecycle identity and validated policy, exposed publicly and reused by resumed jobs and regenerated artifacts. Run removal with retained jobs returns the established invalid-parameter outcome. Persist policies, references, plans, receipts, and dispositions across CacheStore restarts and legacy database migration. Shortlist imports must keep established duplicate and skipped counts while creating durable references.

Planning must be deterministic and side-effect free, distinguish shortlist, workflow, automation, row, and artifact relationships, and return the established not-found outcome for unknown runs without creating state. Execution must reject stale plans atomically, remove only approved resources, and record honest durable partial receipts on failure while retaining affected rows and artifacts. Erased projections cannot be republished. Retained jobs remain readable in every supported export format.

CLI JSON, piped output, TTY, MCP, and wizard operations must expose the same persisted identities, counts, blockers, dispositions, outcomes, and error codes. Stable callable `evide
